selectedQuote: The sky has waited a long time for a calendar that understands it.
modeSubtitle: Two ways to measure time. One follows convention. One follows the sky.
syncDesc: 13 months. Realigns with the Gregorian calendar every April. March length follows the Gregorian leap year rule, keeping the calendar in sync with conventional dates.
trueDesc: 12 months of 28 days + March of 29-30 days. Follows its own pure astronomical cycle -- leap years every 4 years, skipped on the 128th year. More accurate to the actual tropical year. No April realignment.
syncMarchRule: SYNC adds the leap day in March following the Gregorian calendar.
trueMarchRule: TRUE distributes the leap day as a natural part of the 13-month cycle.

hekaAIDesc: Connect your own AI provider for deeper personalization.

syncAccuracyText: 365.2425 days per year -- identical to the Gregorian calendar. Drifts approximately 1 day every 3,216 years from the tropical year.
trueAccuracyText: 365.2421875 days per year -- matched to the actual tropical year. Drifts approximately 1 day every 450,000 years from the Gregorian calendar -- roughly 100x more precise.
syncAlignmentText: Perpetually realigns to April 1st of the civil calendar. Your HEKA dates always correspond to familiar Gregorian dates, making coordination with the outside world effortless.
trueAlignmentText: Follows its own pure astronomical cycle with no realignment to the civil calendar. Leap years occur every 4 years, skipped on the 128th year -- a refinement even the Gregorian calendar lacks.
syncAstrologyText: Defaults to 12-sign tropical zodiac -- the conventional system used by Western astrology, aligned to the seasons.
trueAstrologyText: Defaults to 13-sign sidereal zodiac -- aligned to the actual constellations as they appear in the sky, using the true astronomical boundaries.
syncBestForText: Those beginning their journey with HEKA. SYNC lets you explore the 13-month rhythm while keeping your feet on familiar ground -- civil date overlays, conventional holidays, and easy coordination with the Gregorian world. A gentle entry into a new way of counting time.
trueBestForText: Those who want a calendar built on astronomical precision. TRUE tracks the tropical year to within 1 day per 450,000 years -- a refinement the Gregorian calendar lacks. For anyone who believes time should follow the sun, not convention.
